rules: No value in this file may be shown to a user while release_gate != 'CLEARED'. Clearing requires sign-off by a qualified pediatrician/neonatologist and a second reviewer who opened the primary source.
Values marked USER_SUPPLIED... were provided in the product brief and could not be opened in the 2026-10-06 research session. They are recorded verbatim for verification, not as established facts.
Automated extracts (VERIFIED_IN_SESSION_VIA_AUTOMATED_EXTRACT...) were read through a summarising web reader; a human must re-check each against the PDF/page before release.
No percentile, z-score or LMS values are embedded. Growth data must be imported from the official WHO files listed in growth_references.

conflicts.source_b: SRC_UNICEF_IN_SCHEDULE and SRC_NHM_TD_OG title (Td at 10 & 16 years); product brief also lists Td
conflicts.recommended_product_behavior: Do not show a vaccine name for the 10/16-year slot until a reviewer confirms against the current MoHFW handbook; show 'Tetanus-containing booster - confirm with your vaccinator'.
Use schedule version effective by baby's DOB/visit date; babies due on/after 2023-01-01 get fIPV-3 at 9 months. Never rewrite historical records.

conflicts.source_a: SRC_NHM_KMC_LBW (stable LBW: ~150 -> 180 ml/kg/day after first week)
conflicts.source_b: SRC_WHO_HEP_NFS_21_41 (<2.5 kg: start 60, +20/day, up to 180-200 ml/kg/day); SRC_WHO_PRETERM_LBW_2022 A.8 (advance up to 30 ml/kg/day)
conflicts.difference: Upper volume and advancement rate differ
conflicts.recommended_product_behavior: Never pick one automatically. Show only the care-team's documented plan; references shown side-by-side in clinician mode with sources.

conflicts.source_a: Product brief: snacks may be appropriate 12-24 months
conflicts.source_b: SRC_WHO_IYCF_FACTSHEET: '3-4 meals per day for infants 9-23 months of age, with 1-2 additional snacks as required'
conflicts.recommended_product_behavior: Display WHO fact-sheet wording verbatim; reviewer to confirm against 2023 guideline text.
Do not ship IAP schedule until 2025 content is verified and loaded as a new version.

conflicts.difference: Different products (e.g., Pentavalent vs DTwP/DTaP+Hib+HepB; fIPV vs IPV; MR vs MMR; additional vaccines in IAP)
conflicts.recommended_product_behavior: Parent selects ONE schedule per baby (changeable, versioned). Never merge. Doses given are recorded as given, independent of schedule.
